salmanshh_lumencast.name: LumenCast
salmanshh_lumencast.description: Mesh-driven line of sight and dynamic lighting for world objects.

batcherHandshake.name: Batcher handshake
batcherHandshake.desc: Allow LumenBatch to claim this light for batched rendering.

obstacleMode.name: Obstacle mode
obstacleMode.desc: How obstacle candidates are collected each tick.

obstacleObjects.name: Obstacle object
obstacleObjects.desc: Seed obstacle object type for custom object mode.

obstacleTag.name: Obstacle tag
obstacleTag.desc: Primary instance tag used in tag obstacle mode.

detectionTag.name: Detection tag
detectionTag.desc: Instance tag used for enter and exit detection events.

lightRadius.name: Light radius
lightRadius.desc: Maximum ray distance in world pixels.

rayArc.name: Ray arc
rayArc.desc: Angular sweep in degrees centered on the facing direction.

rayCount.name: Ray count
rayCount.desc: Number of primary rays cast per update.

facingAngle.name: Facing angle
facingAngle.desc: Angle offset added to the host object's angle.

meshDeformEnabled.name: Mesh deform enabled
meshDeformEnabled.desc: Write the visibility polygon to the host object's mesh each tick.

detectionInterval.name: Detection interval
detectionInterval.desc: Seconds between detection sweeps. Zero means every tick.

debugOverlay.name: Debug overlay
debugOverlay.desc: Draw debugger information in preview builds when available.

ClearDetectedObjects.description: Clear the cached visible set used for enter and exit events.

ForceDetectionSweep.description: Immediately test all detection-tagged objects against the current polygon.

DisableMeshDeform.description: Stop deforming the host mesh until re-enabled.

EnableMeshDeform.description: Resume writing the visibility polygon to the host mesh.

ResetMesh.description: Restore the mesh to a flat state and disable deformation.

SetMeshPinOrigin.description: Move the mesh fan origin in normalized host space.

AddObstacleObject.description: Register an object type for custom object obstacle mode.

objectType.name: Object
objectType.desc: Object type to treat as an obstacle.

AddObstacleTag.description: Add a secondary obstacle tag in tag mode.

ClearObstacleObjects.description: Remove every registered custom obstacle object type.

RemoveObstacleObject.description: Unregister an object type from custom object obstacle mode.

RemoveObstacleTag.description: Remove a tag from the active obstacle tag set.

SetCullMode.description: Choose whether obstacle candidates are AABB-culled by radius.

SetDetectionTag.description: Choose which tagged instances fire LoS enter and exit events.

SetFacingAngle.description: Set the cone angle offset relative to the host object.

SetLightRadius.display-text: Set line of sight range to {0}
SetLightRadius.description: Set the maximum ray distance in pixels.

SetObstacleMode.description: Switch how obstacle candidates are collected.

SetObstacleTag.description: Replace the primary obstacle tag used in tag mode.

SetRayArc.display-text: Set cone of view to {0} degrees
SetRayArc.description: Set the angular sweep of the visibility cone.

SetRayCount.description: Set the number of primary rays cast each update.

IsBatchRendered.description: True if a batcher is currently suppressing individual mesh writes.

OnBatcherAttached.description: Triggered when a LumenBatch instance claims this light.

OnBatcherDetached.description: Triggered when a LumenBatch instance releases this light.

OnObjectEnterLoS.list-name: On object enter line of sight
OnObjectEnterLoS.display-text: On object enter line of sight
OnObjectEnterLoS.description: Triggered when a detection-tagged object becomes visible.

OnObjectExitLoS.list-name: On object leave line of sight
OnObjectExitLoS.display-text: On object leave line of sight
OnObjectExitLoS.description: Triggered when a detection-tagged object is no longer visible.

HasObstacleObject.description: Check whether an object type is registered as a custom obstacle.

HasObstacleTag.description: Check whether a tag is in the active obstacle tag set.

IsMeshDeformEnabled.description: True when polygon data is currently written to the host mesh.

IsObstacleModeActive.description: Check whether a given obstacle mode is currently active.

OnObstacleModeChanged.description: Triggered after the active obstacle mode changes.

OnObstacleTagChanged.description: Triggered after the primary obstacle tag changes in tag mode.

IsObjectInLoS.list-name: Has line of sight to object
IsObjectInLoS.display-text: Has line of sight to object UID {0}
IsObjectInLoS.description: Check whether the given UID is currently inside the cached visibility polygon.

IsPointInVisibility.description: Check whether a world-space point is inside the current visibility polygon.

OnMeshNotReady.description: Triggered when mesh deformation is enabled but no writable mesh is found.

OnPolygonUpdated.description: Triggered after the visibility polygon is recomputed.

OnRayHit.description: Triggered for each primary ray that hits an obstacle.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: Optional tag filter in tag obstacle mode.

BatcherUID.description: UID of the LumenBatch instance currently rendering this light, or -1.

CountVisibleObjects.description: Number of currently visible detection-tagged objects.

GetVisibleObjectUID.description: UID of a visible object by index.

LoSEntrantUID.description: UID of the object that just entered line of sight.

LoSExitantUID.description: UID of the object that just left line of sight.

RayHitAngle.description: Angle in degrees of the current ray hit.

RayHitUID.description: UID of the obstacle hit by the current ray.

RayHitX.description: World X of the current ray hit.

RayHitY.description: World Y of the current ray hit.

ActiveFacingAngle.description: Current facing angle offset in degrees.

ActiveObstacleTag.description: Current primary obstacle tag, or an empty string outside tag mode.

ActiveRayArc.description: Current cone of view in degrees.

CountObstacleObjects.description: Number of registered custom obstacle object types.

CountPolyPoints.description: Number of points in the current visibility polygon.

GetPolyHitUID.description: UID hit by a visibility polygon point, or -1 if unobstructed.

GetPolyPointAngle.description: Angle in degrees of a visibility polygon point.

GetPolyPointDist.description: Distance from the origin to a visibility polygon point.

GetPolyPointX.description: World X of a visibility polygon point.

GetPolyPointY.description: World Y of a visibility polygon point.

LastPolygonUpdateTime.description: Runtime timestamp of the most recent polygon update.

PolygonArea.description: Approximate area of the current visibility polygon.
